caveat: retailer product photograph, no colour chart, unknown white balance; the numbers are what the photograph shows

plate.note: median of the light, warm pixels inside the outline and clear of every key, knob and LED; p10 and p90 show the lighting across the plate

frame.note: median of the dark pixels in the strips left and right of the plate outline (the wenge cheeks)

key_face.note: median over all keys of the central 3 px radius; a chrome ball has a highlight, so p10 to p90 is wide

led_off.note: median of the dots with no hue; the photograph's dots are about 3 px across, so this is a blend with the plate round them

ink.note: the darkest 1 percent of plate pixels clear of keys; printed names are about 4 px high so this is a blur of the ink with the plate and is lighter than the ink
